svg.text: EF101-P11 Computer Hardware Inventory and Maintenance System: project schema
Version 23. Everything runs on one computer: Flask and segno are installed into venv/ once; at run time nothing is loaded from the Internet.
• Asset page, fault log, QR label
• QR label sheet and Scan page
style.css: plain CSS, light and dark
wrong CPU family; closing needs all
COUNT / GROUP BY for totals and
charts (all add up to the total)
a blank box keeps the total
db.py: get_db() opens the database with foreign keys ON; init_db() runs schema.sql
Tests: backend/test_app.py (313 checks, temporary database), started by run-tests.*
no cost: it lives in assets.status_cost
The QR feature adds no table or column: labels are
built from the assets columns when they are asked for.
database/ also holds schema.sql, db.py, queries.py,
seed.py, migrate.py and backups/ (created when needed).
What happens when you press Save
Errors: the form is shown again with messages, nothing is saved
OK: a parameterised INSERT writes the row, then commit()
Redirect to the asset page: a SELECT shows the new record
Dashboard and CSV export read the same tables
A fault stays open as steps (no history yet); setting the PC Operational
writes ONE history entry with every step and the single Updated Cost.
Retiring an asset sets active = 0: it disappears from lists but its history stays.
What happens when you scan a QR label (version 20 and later)
Scan page reads the code in the browser (jsQR), or a typed ID
POST /api/scan-lookup: code_to_asset_id() maps the text to an asset ID
The live asset page opens (the code itself is only a snapshot)
Project files and what each one does
routes, validation, CSV, reports, backup (no SQL)
CPU / family lists and the match rule (no db change)
label text, QR code (segno), scan text to asset ID
every SQL statement; opens SQLite, keys on
CREATE TABLE for all four tables
40 demo assets + 43 events; upgrade an old db
the data file (backups/ holds timestamped copies)
two-click launchers: package check + install menu
test launcher: same menu, shows what is missing
Also in the project folder: README.md, TEAM_SPLIT.md, docs/ (this diagram), changelogs/,
scripts/ (launcher code). Outputs: dashboard, QR labels, printable reports, CSV for Excel.
